timeline.title: Neeraj Yadav's friend says she met him hours before he was found dead beside SUV
timeline.description: During inquiry, a woman who had brought Yadav to the hospital told police she had been friends with him since Dec 2025. According to her statement, she went to Sonipat on Oct 27 to meet Yadav and tell him she could no longer remain in touch with him. She told police Yadav later dropped her off at Maujpur in his SUV. Around 9pm, when the woman returned to the area near Gate No. 1 of Maujpur metro station to check on him, she found him lying on the road beside his vehicle and rushed him to hospital.

Candidates involved in violent activities aiming for regime change could be denied government jobs. However, political ideology alone cannot disqualify individuals from employment. The mere registration of an FIR or ongoing investigations will not automatically make candidates ineligible. Decisions on eligibility will depend on specific circumstances related to the verification rules.

timeline.title: 'Better late than never': Why did F1 leave India, and why is it back on the agenda?
timeline.description: Tax disputes ended the Indian Grand Prix after three races. Thirteen years later, the government has put Formula 1 back on its agenda, with a task force examining the challenges that led to the sport’s exit, including taxation, import duties and commercial arrangements. As India targets a possible 2028 return, the big question is whether it can put the right framework in place for F1 to return - and stay.
